d:
What if love had never brought two hearts together? Experience the beautiful melody of “Aap Jo Mere Meet Na Hote” from the film Geet (1992), featuring the charming Divya Bharti and Avinash Wadhawan. Rendered in the soulful voice of Lata Mangeshkar, this romantic classic beautifully expresses the emotions of love and togetherness.
